t: From Blog Chaos to Book Outline: An AI-Powered Information Architecture Journey
s: This article chronicles a strategic pivot from complex local RAG to leveraging frontier LLMs (like Gemini) with massive context windows for blog content analysis and restructuring, aiming for an AI-navigable information architecture.
sub: Strategic pivot from local RAG to large context LLMs
Information architecture for LLM-driven site navigation (5-click depth)
Utilizing large context windows (Gemini 1.5 Pro 2M tokens) for direct content ingestion
AI-powered content analysis and restructuring for book outlining
